subject.title: feat(cli): `skills uninstall` design proposal + prior art reconciliation

question: Should OpenClaw add `openclaw skills uninstall <slug>` now, and should it remove only ClawHub-tracked installs or also manually copied skill directories?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the operation is destructive and changes the public CLI lifecycle contract, so automation should not choose the permanent semantics alone.

options.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
options.body: Add a workspace/global-aware CLI command that removes a safe resolved skill directory and lockfile entry, with explicit behavior for non-ClawHub/manual skills.

options.title: Defer to Gateway-first lifecycle
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a shared Gateway/lifecycle design before adding the CLI surface.

options.title: Reject core uninstall for now
options.body: Close or defer the feature and document the supported manual cleanup path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow CLI uninstall
recommendation.body: Add a workspace/global-aware CLI command that removes a safe resolved skill directory and lockfile entry, with explicit behavior for non-ClawHub/manual skills.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on ClawHub update policy and current CLI/lifecycle lines makes this the best available routing candidate.
